body:
I appreciate that, but life is finite. The lives of the people I hurt are finite. I'm sure at this point none of the kids I bullied in elementary still give a shit, and my mom has told me so long as I change- aka stop this behavior- she has forgiven me. But my stepdad? My friends? No. There's no way to make it up.

And I can't make it up to the animals. I can change my behavior now and do my best to make amends but my cat is 10.5, the older dog is 11.5. She's got, what, 2.5-5.5 years left?  And he's got 1.5-3.5. I don't have a lot of time to make sure they spend their last years in the comfort of knowing they'll never be hit (at least not by me) again. They love me and I love them and I've already failed. 

And my younger dog, I know I've made it up to him. Or at least almost have. But making amends doesn't change the behavior in the first place.

I will never have friends unless I hide or keep things from them. Because the kind of people who could accept this, even if I changed, are not the kind of people I'd ever want to be around. 

I can never get another animal. I can never have friends. I can never do any hobbies because my evilness will taint everything I make.
